rationale: Roughly 78% of today's volume (2.85M of 3.64M shares) printed in a single one-minute candle that lifted price from $5.26 to $5.29 — a one-print profile more consistent with a block crossing than organic accumulation, and it carries no directional information by itself. Price is now pressed into a resistance confluence (prior-day low $5.28, prior close $5.31) on a risk-off tape with no news to validate the burst, so chasing long risks buying a data artifact into supply, and fading it means shorting directly against a massive buy print. With the loss budget nearly exhausted and no follow-through prints yet to confirm either side, both directions are closer to coin-flip odds than a tradeable edge.
